criteria.title: Biomes and terrain plausibility
criteria.method: Independent source audit, real-callback bounded probes, built Chromium UI and exact full-tree bridge; scope details in independent-review.json.
criteria.criterion_evidence: The shared24-biome policy and localized mountain/swamp risk were inspected; manual editing leaves geographic map and RNG literal in bounded callbacks.
limitations: No500-map expert study, approved distribution tolerances or full hard-invariant/game cohort audit.

criteria.title: Hex editing
criteria.method: Independent source audit, real-callback bounded probes, built Chromium UI and exact full-tree bridge; scope details in independent-review.json.
criteria.criterion_evidence: Common overrides persist with validatedv11 save/load; E7/E8 remap discovery identity while coordinate difficulty stays; water/generic deletion/checkpoint losses gated; exact UndoRedo observed. Legacy authored mode regression independently found and fixed.

double_counting: Shared artifacts are cited only for distinct subclaims. No criterion grade or points awarded, no projected uplift applied, no whole-cohort claim.
regression_status: Two bounded findings resolved and independently rechecked at final tree; no open blocking source findings in reviewed scope.
external_validation: Root full check/browser and exact-public-head CI pending at time of assessment; must be appended before acceptance/release handoff.
release_status: Unreleased; separate owner approval required. current-score/history not modified by reviewer.
